product_one_liner.value: Obsidian provides SaaS and AI-agent security that helps enterprise security teams monitor business applications, detect threats, manage access and enforce compliance.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage describes complete SaaS security across business apps.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page shows a free tier and quote-based paid plans.

named_customers.notes: All three appear on the customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn shows company size 51–200 (which overlaps two bands); Forbes lists 200 employees, supporting the 101–200 band.

hq_location.notes: Company profile lists Palo Alto, California, United States.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is primarily product announcements and security/marketing content; it does not show two technical posts by engineers describing how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Homepage links to the Trust Center but no public product documentation/help center or developer portal; trust documentation requires access.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live listing for AI Security Engineer - Taiwan.

model_provider.notes: Publicly found material discusses integrations with multiple AI vendors but does not establish an AI model provider used by Obsidian's product.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Center names SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 among certifications; other listed ISO standards are outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: Company announced $85 million Series D financing in August 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 Series D is within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current open roles include multiple Enterprise Account Executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: A dated announcement for the Context-Aware Runtime Decision Engine appeared November 10, 2026, within the requested six-month window relative to November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company leadership page and dated leadership announcement disclose no C-level or VP-level join or departure in the 12-month window; the reported leadership hires were in July 2025, outside it.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The company has public integration pages for HubSpot and Salesforce Marketing Cloud; these indicate supported application integrations, not necessarily internal CRM use.
